Subject: Intro / Redwood trial walkthrough + IT readiness

Hi Marcus — thanks for signing up for the trial and for the quick intro via Aisha.

We'd love to run a focused walkthrough to: 1) show the trial UX, 2) confirm expected integrations / network constraints for your environment, and 3) align on success criteria for the POC. Suggested plan: 30–45m demo (AE + SE) with a short 10–15m IT readiness pre-call if your security team prefers to gate the demo.

Do any of these slots work on your side (all ET):
- Tue Aug 31 — 10:00–10:45
- Wed Sep 1 — 14:00–14:45
- Thu Sep 2 — 09:00–09:45

If none of those fit, tell us two 30–60m windows that work and we’ll adapt. I’ve attached a short trial-template.pdf to show what we typically cover and a one-page IT checklist for network/port expectations (IT checklist is a stub in this thread).

Thanks — looping Ben (AE) + Karthik (SE) to join. Aisha, feel free to add background notes from the SDR handoff.

—Olga

olga.petrov@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Thanks, Olga — appreciate the clear options. Quick context: I’m on the integrations team (PST) and Tom (cc’d) is our security lead. We’re excited to see the trial.

Out of the slots you proposed the Tue Aug 31 10:00 ET one works best on my side (that’s 07:00 PT for me). If Ben/Karthik think 45m is better, we’re fine with that.

Also — Tom’s team typically asks for a short pre-call to cover network whitelisting and any potential outbound IPs. Could we do a 15m IT pre-call right before the demo (e.g., 09:45–10:00 ET)? If you can send a quick checklist / list of ports and any SSO hints, that’ll help speed internal approvals.

Marcus

Hi all — Tom here (security). Thanks for coordinating. We do prefer a short pre-call to cover network/egress and any data handling specifics before broader demos. 15 minutes is usually enough. Please include any IP ranges, domains to whitelist, and whether the trial will connect to our VPC or use a hosted flow.

We also request a one-page summary of what data (if any) is logged during the trial and retention windows — a couple of bullet points will do. If you can share the it-checklist.xlsx, that would help.

Thanks,
Tom Carter
Lead InfoSec, Kestrel Health

Subject: Confirmed: Tue Aug 31 — 10:00–10:45 ET (45m demo) + 09:45–10:00 ET IT pre-call

Thanks, Tom and Marcus — confirmed. Final plan:
- IT pre-call: Tue Aug 31, 09:45–10:00 ET (15m) — Karthik (SE) + Tom (InfoSec) + Olga on invite
- Demo: Tue Aug 31, 10:00–10:45 ET (45m) — Ben (AE) + Karthik (SE) + Marcus + broader Kestrel attendees as needed

I’ve attached the it-checklist.xlsx (network ports, outbound domains, sample retention bullets) and re-attached the trial-template.pdf. Calendar invite is here: https://cal.redwood.ai/invite/abc123. HubSpot record for the trial is: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/record/67890.

A few quick notes for the pre-call:
- Typical outbound domains: *.redwood.ai, api.redwood.ai
- Common ports: 443 outbound (TLS). We’ll confirm IPs if you need concrete ranges for whitelisting.
- Trial data retention for the sandbox: default 7 days unless a retention policy is requested; we do not share PII externally in hosted trial logs by default.

Ben/Karthik — please join the IT pre-call and the main demo. Marcus/Tom — if you want additional internal stakeholders on the invite, reply-all and I’ll add them.

See you Tue — I’ll send the calendar invite and attach the files.

—Olga
